hooks.command: set -o pipefail; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && dotnet build -c Release --nologo -v q 2>&1 | tail -5 && dotnet test tests/UrlShortener.UnitTests -c Release --no-build --nologo -v q 2>&1 | tail -5 || { echo 'Stop gate: dotnet build or unit tests failed; fix before finishing.' >&2; exit 2; }
hooks.statusMessage: Stop gate: dotnet build + unit tests
